about_the_game:
Once Before Us is a cooperative puzzle adventure for two players.
Communication and observation are the only ways forward - every riddle, mechanism, and clue requires teamwork and focus. Together, you’ll explore forgotten places, solve challenges that test both logic and connection.

  •  Two-Player Co-op – Built entirely around collaboration. Every puzzle requires both players to act, react, and think together. No solo mode.

  •  Challenging Puzzles – Each area introduces new ways to communicate and coordinate. Attention to detail and clear teamwork are key.

  • Environmental Interactions – Push, pull, trigger, and combine elements to solve physical and logical challenges.

  • Narrative Element – The players are guided by someone who speaks to them along the way. They don’t know who he is or why he’s helping - at least, not yet.

  • Occasional Tension – While not a horror game, some moments may surprise or disturb.

You and your partner are not just solving puzzles – you're uncovering what was once before you… and perhaps, what’s still ahead.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.8 GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.5 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
